def compress(grid):
    """The grid without its frontiers: every row and every column that is one color throughout."""
    rows = {i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1}
    cols = {j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[j] for row in grid}) == 1}
    return [[v for j, v in enumerate(row) if j not in cols] for i, row in enumerate(grid) if i not in rows]

def upscale(grid, factor):
    """Each cell as a factor x factor block of its color."""
    return [[v for v in row for _ in range(factor)] for row in grid for _ in range(factor)]

def crop(grid, top, left, height, width):
    """The height x width subgrid whose top-left cell is (top, left)."""
    return [row[left:left + width] for row in grid[top:top + height]]

def trim(grid):
    """The grid without its outermost rows and columns."""
    return [row[1:-1] for row in grid[1:-1]]

def replace(grid, old, new):
    """The grid with every cell of color old recolored new."""
    return [[new if v == old else v for v in row] for row in grid]

def hperiod(grid):
    """The smallest p such that every row repeats itself every p cells: the grid's width if none is smaller."""
    w = len(grid[0])
    return next(p for p in range(1, w + 1) if all(row[j] == row[j - p] for row in grid for j in range(p, w)))

from collections import Counter
def transform2(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    bg=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    drows=[i for i in range(h) if len(set(grid[i]))==1 and grid[i][0]!=bg]
    dcols=[j for j in range(w) if len({grid[i][j] for i in range(h)})==1 and grid[0][j]!=bg]
    rseg=[]; s=0
    for i in drows+[h]:
        if i>s: rseg.append((s,i))
        s=i+1
    cseg=[]; s=0
    for j in dcols+[w]:
        if j>s: cseg.append((s,j))
        s=j+1
    def cell(rs,cs): return [row[cs[0]:cs[1]] for row in grid[rs[0]:rs[1]]]
    cells=[(rs,cs) for rs in rseg for cs in cseg]
    content=min(cells,key=lambda c: sum(v==bg for row in cell(*c) for v in row))
    print('bg',bg,'rseg',rseg,'cseg',cseg,'content',content)
    C=cell(*content)
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for rs,cs in cells:
        for i in range(rs[1]-rs[0]):
            for j in range(cs[1]-cs[0]):
                out[rs[0]+i][cs[0]+j]=C[i][j]
    return out

import json,os

lib='''def background(grid):
    """The most frequent cell color of the grid."""
    from collections import Counter
    return Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]

def uniform_rows(grid, color=None):
    """Rows that are one color throughout (optionally only rows of a given color)."""
    return [i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and (color is None or row[0] == color)]

def uniform_cols(grid, color=None):
    """Columns that are one color throughout (optionally only columns of a given color)."""
    h = len(grid)
    return [j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if len({grid[i][j] for i in range(h)}) == 1 and (color is None or grid[0][j] == color)]

def segments(dividers, end):
    """[(start, end)] spans between sorted divider indices, skipping empties, up to end."""
    out, s = [], 0
    for i in dividers + [end]:
        if i > s:
            out.append((s, i))
        s = i + 1
    return out

def cells_of(grid, drows, dcols):
    """Subgrids of the partition cut by the given divider row and column indices."""
    return [[ [row[c0:c1] for row in grid[r0:r1]] for (c0, c1) in segments(dcols, len(grid[0])) ] for (r0, r1) in segments(drows, len(grid))]

def tile_cells(grid):
    """Split the grid into cells cut by full lines of the non-background color, and tile the least-background cell into every cell."""
    from collections import Counter
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = background(grid)
    drows = [i for i in range(h) if len(set(grid[i])) == 1 and grid[i][0] != bg]
    dcols = [j for j in range(w) if len({grid[i][j] for i in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][j] != bg]
    rsegs, csegs = segments(drows, h), segments(dcols, w)
    def cell(rs, cs):
        return [row[cs[0]:cs[1]] for row in grid[rs[0]:rs[1]]]
    cells = [(rs, cs) for rs in rsegs for cs in csegs]
    content = min(cells, key=lambda c: sum(v == bg for row in cell(*c) for v in row))
    C = cell(*content)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for rs, cs in cells:
        for i in range(rs[1] - rs[0]):
            for j in range(cs[1] - cs[0]):
                out[rs[0] + i][cs[0] + j] = C[i][j]
    return out
'''
